import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2 + p[3]*T**3
            + (p[4] + p[5]*T + p[6]*T**2)/eps + p[7]*L/eps
            + L*(p[8] + p[9]*T**4))
